sql: select id, created_at, level, component, left(message,160) as msg from system_events where created_at > '2026-10-27 02:50:00+00' and (component ilike '%boot%' or component ilike '%start%' or message ilike '%start%' or message ilike '%taxonomy%' or message ilike '%platform%' or component ilike '%experiment%') order by id limit 40
